messages:
sara-sales: Customer needs our pen-test PDF, vuln-scan exports, and a SIG/CAIQ CSV mapping for their vendor intake tool. Can we produce a sanitized bundle + ETA?

sara-sales: Uploaded initial artifacts: <https://files.redwood.com/share/pen_test_q1_2026_redacted.pdf|pen_test_q1_2026_redacted.pdf> and <https://files.redwood.com/share/vulnscan_2026-04-01.zip|vulnscan_2026-04-01.zip>

secops-bot: Upload recorded (audit id u-2026-1122). Share link set to customer-sme@acme.com (view only).

mira-sec: I spot-checked redaction: no PII. Scan summary: 3 findings total — 2 medium, 1 low. Medium A requires upstream vendor patch (runtime-crypto). Medium B is gateway config (we can fix). Low is dependency update (already planned).

customer-sme: Please provide owners, remediation ETA, re-scan date + artifact, and a CSV mapping find->CVE->CAIQ control for ingestion. Also need signed attestation after re-scan.

lee-runtime: I'll own coordination for the runtime patch with vendor-relations. Tentative vendor patch ETA 2026-04-15; I'll push for earlier backport.

ron-eng: I can take the gateway config change and plan prod rollout 2026-04-09 (ticket INF-4477).

vendor-relations: I've pinged the upstream vendor; they acknowledged and gave tentative release window. I'll update with firm date by EOD.

mira-sec: Proposed timeline we can commit to for procurement:
- 2026-04-09: gateway config rollout (ron-eng)
- 2026-04-15: vendor patch expected (lee-runtime)
- 2026-04-16: canary + smoke tests
- 2026-04-18: internal re-scan (job rs-2026-745)
- 2026-04-19: deliver re-scan report + SIG/CAIQ CSV + signed attestation PDF

customer-sme: That schedule should be fine if you provide a signed attestation and the re-scan report. Include ticket links and evidence of fixes.

mira-sec: CSV format I'll produce: find_id,cve,control_id,control_family,remediation_status. Example row: FIND-2026-778,CVE-2026-9001,CC-6.1,Configuration Management,in_progress

lee-runtime: Post-deploy verification command we will run:
`./infra/tools/run_vuln_check --target runtime-service --ids FIND-2026-778 --output rescan-2026-04-18.json`

secops-bot: Re-scan job rs-2026-745 scheduled for 2026-04-18 02:00 UTC. Results will be archived at /sec/runs/rs-2026-745 and posted to this channel.

sara-sales: I'll be the procurement contact for the buyer and will send the final bundle when we have the re-scan + signed attestation.

mira-sec: Evidence bundle will include: sanitized pen-test PDF, original scanner outputs (sanitized), vulnerability tracker export mapping internal IDs->CVEs, SIG/CAIQ CSV, ticket links, and signed attestation. If vendor patch delays, we'll include documented compensating controls (WAF rules + monitoring) with evidence.

lee-runtime: Action items: confirm vendor patch date by EOD, coordinate patch rollout and canary windows.

ron-eng: Action: deploy gateway config 2026-04-09 and post verification logs here.

vendor-relations: Action: follow up with vendor and attach confirmation to this thread.

secops-bot: Reminder set: post-rescan automation will notify this channel when /sec/runs/rs-2026-745 is available.

sara-sales: Thanks everyone — I'll update the customer today with the proposed timeline and owners. :white_check_mark:
